verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is an inference API platform, and a built-in assistant in its Cloud Console is a fair thing to ask about, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a model playground and a chat trial for testing hosted models; neither is documented as an in-product assistant that takes delegated tasks within the product. These count as adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
